module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Report the products whose stock has fallen below their reorder level.

import std.console
import std.environment
import std.filesystem
import std.filesystem exposing Path
import std.json

public type Product
  purpose: One stocked product as listed in the input file.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer
  has reorder_level: Integer
  can FromJson
end

public type AppError is one of
  purpose: The ways the report can fail.
  MissingPath
  BadFile(detail: Text)
end

public function low_stock(products: List of Product)
  returns List of Product
  purpose: Keep the products below their reorder level, lowest stock first.
  tags: inventory
  example: low_stock([]) is []

  return
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock
    collect product
end

public function describe(product: Product)
  returns Text
  purpose: Render one product as a report line.
  tags: inventory
  example: describe(Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 2, reorder_level: 5)) is "Bolt: 2 in stock, reorder at 5"

  return "{product.name}: {product.stock} in stock, reorder at {product.reorder_level}"
end

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, filesystem.read, environment
  purpose: Read the product file named by the first argument and print the low-stock lines.

  let arguments be environment.arguments()
  let first_argument be arguments.first() otherwise fail with MissingPath
  let text be filesystem.read_text(Path(first_argument)) otherwise fail with BadFile(detail: "cannot read the file")
  let products: List of Product be json.parse(text) otherwise fail with BadFile(detail: "not valid product JSON")
  for each product in low_stock(products)
    console.print(describe(product))
  end
end
